nodes.label: Project maintenance instructions
Graph-first structural navigation
nodes.rationale: Query existing graph before broad source reads; inspect source when graph is missing, stale or unavailable.

nodes.label: Private-data exclusion from project graph
nodes.rationale: Student identifiers, hashes, credentials, exports, database contents and backups remain excluded.

nodes.label: Frontend implementation conventions
nodes.rationale: React JSX, shared foundation.css/ui.jsx, Font Awesome webfonts and Recharts remain the shared conventions.

nodes.label: Implemented auth queue and simulator truth boundaries
nodes.rationale: FastAPI/XAMPP queue and auth exist; physical ESP32 remains disconnected. Admin neutral themes and player reference palette remain distinct.

nodes.label: Existing html5-qrcode scanner API requirement
nodes.rationale: Use html5-qrcode camera/file APIs and documented content-entry contract; do not replace with a custom decoder.

nodes.label: Implemented FastAPI XAMPP development backend
Single event cabinet Classic v1 backend scope
nodes.rationale: Single event acs-day and cabinet-01, proposed Classic v1; no ESP32 firmware or AI provider implementation.

nodes.label: Primary Python3.13 backend .venv environment
nodes.rationale: Normal backend/.venv is primary; earlier .tools/backend-venv is a compatibility fallback.

nodes.label: Repeatable local database provisioning and runtime account
nodes.rationale: Project-only setup applies migrations and restricted account; reruns preserve data and passwords. Runtime never uses root.

nodes.label: Administrator password cookie and CSRF defenses
nodes.rationale: Argon2id, separate opaque admin/player cookies, expiry/revocation, HttpOnly/SameSite Strict, CSRF and same-origin writes; login throttling and no public signup.

nodes.label: Implemented keyed encrypted private student identity
nodes.rationale: HMAC lookup and AES-256-GCM with per-record nonce; preserve leading zeros and never expose ID/hash/ciphertext in dashboard/player responses.

nodes.label: Implemented FIFO locking and duplicate protection
nodes.rationale: FIFO joined_at/id, event/cabinet locks and READ COMMITTED; live-ticket/active-round uniqueness, idempotent call and reason-required audited skip.

nodes.label: Atomic replayed results notification and outbox
nodes.rationale: Replay placements to score; terminal, placements, queue, notification and outbox commit together. Identical retry ACK and conflict rejection remain.

nodes.label: Authorized development simulator with source-separated ranking
nodes.rationale: Simulator results are marked/source-separated and disabled before real events. No physical device is implied.

nodes.label: Two-second polling and browser notification limitations
nodes.rationale: Open-page polling and optional permissioned alerts; no closed-tab push, SMS, email or WebSocket server claim.

nodes.label: Phone networking TLS and operational readiness gaps
nodes.rationale: Reachable public URL/trusted HTTPS/secure cookies required for real phone IDs. No automatic firewall/router changes; production and physical recovery validation remain.

nodes.label: Disposable MariaDB synthetic integration test boundary
nodes.rationale: Dedicated test servers and disposable databases use synthetic identities; review artifacts and application database are not semantic inputs.

nodes.label: Pinned backend dependency manifest
Pinned FastAPI SQLAlchemy PyMySQL Uvicorn runtime
nodes.rationale: Manifest pins FastAPI0.163.1, SQLAlchemy2.1.8, PyMySQL1.2.4 and Uvicorn0.54.0; presence of websockets package does not establish an implemented WebSocket server.

nodes.label: Pinned Argon2 and cryptography security dependencies
nodes.rationale: Manifest pins argon2-cffi25.1.0 and cryptography50.0.2 for password and authenticated-encryption support.

nodes.label: Functional specification baseline
Proposed classic-v1 game rules
nodes.rationale: Proposed eight columns,12scored rows,60seconds,three-cell foundation and deterministic timing require physical play-testing; device firmware is not connected.

nodes.label: Proposed overlap scoring and accuracy
nodes.rationale: 100points per successful row plus25perfect; overlap ratio is game-derived rather than physical sensor accuracy. Backend replays evidence per current implementation.

nodes.label: Scoped metric denominators and local-day bounds
nodes.rationale: Completed games differ from registrations; distinct participants and attempted-level failure denominators matter. Local-day bounds convert from Asia/Manila to UTC.

nodes.label: Pending physical hardware performance and recovery acceptance
nodes.rationale: Performance, real disconnect/power loss, backups and physical rounds remain acceptance targets; current development tests cannot prove them.

nodes.label: Local Graphify setup and freshness workflow
Graphifyy 0.9.109 isolated local package
nodes.rationale: Package graphifyy has two y characters; CLI is graphify, with watch and sql extras.

nodes.label: Structural updates versus document semantic refresh
nodes.rationale: AST update preserves existing semantics; meaningful document edits need host-assisted semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Optional structural file watcher
nodes.rationale: Watcher status is recorded separately; it is not a Windows startup service and does not semantically re-read docs.

nodes.label: Local graph is navigation evidence not runtime truth
nodes.rationale: No hosted MCP is configured; map cannot prove live state, test results or provisional-plan approval.

nodes.label: Local React and backend setup
Documented user-installed Node24 npm11 and Python3.13 versions
nodes.rationale: Document records Node24.22.3,npm11.19.1,Python3.13.17 installed for Windowsuser. Backend/.venv has pinnedrequirements; frontend uses package scripts/npm lockfile. No actualenvironment inspection is implied by semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Restart terminal application after user PATH setup
nodes.rationale: Reopen terminalapp,including integrated VSCode/Codex terminals,to receive updateduserPATH; documented checks node/npm/python --version are instructions not checks run here.

nodes.label: Start XAMPP MySQL before application servers
nodes.rationale: XAMPPdatabase is prerequisite; open twoPowerShellterminals. Frontend/backendcommands do not startDB or changecredentials.

nodes.label: Primary React npm development command
nodes.rationale: From D:/iot-dashboard/frontend run npm run dev. React/Vite are projectdependencies rather than global commands.

nodes.label: Direct backend .venv uvicorn startup without activation
nodes.rationale: From backend run ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port8000 --no-access-log. Direct interpreter avoidsPowerShellactivation.

nodes.label: Local admin login and explicit server shutdown
nodes.rationale: Open localhost:5173/admin/login; Ctrl+C in eachterminal stopsitsserver. Neitherstartupcommand startsXAMPP or modifiesDBcredentials.

nodes.label: npm ci and Python virtual environment dependency reinstall
nodes.rationale: Frontend npm ci. Backend python -m venv .venv then .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt; newmachine needsNodeLTS/Python andbackendDBsetup.

nodes.label: Independent Node install and Windows npm cmd entrypoint
nodes.rationale: Node is independentofCodexbundledruntime/onuserPATH. PowerShell uses npm Windows.cmd through Programs/NodeCommands; executionpolicy unchanged. Oldlaunchersoptional,normalnpm/Pythonprimary.

nodes.label: Keep backend environment credentials and database private
nodes.rationale: Do notindexorcommit .env,virtualenvironment,DBcontents orcredentials; setupdocumentation contains directions rather than permission toreadsecrets.

nodes.label: Current QR player flow and administrator access
nodes.rationale: Current document distinguishes registration, queue waiting, explicit staff reservation and physical/simulator round controls.

nodes.label: Current access implementation supersedes earlier preview and public assumptions
nodes.rationale: Player QR entry, authenticated admin access and neutral admin themes supersede earlier preview/public assumptions; player reference styling remains.

nodes.label: Scanner detection checked before two-hour HttpOnly entry grant
nodes.rationale: Root/scan uses existing html5-qrcode camera or image API. Join URL alone opens scanner and grants nothing; backend checks detected registered content before private entry grant. QR contents remain a public capability, not physical camera attestation.

nodes.label: Server registration with unused entry grant and private identity
nodes.rationale: Required nickname/private student ID/notice; admissions checked transactionally with persisted FIFO ticket. Existing authenticated player may continue. Registration does not automatically call or start a round.

nodes.label: Owner-only persistent ticket across refreshes
nodes.rationale: Private player session selects only own ticket; waiting-only cancellation. Public code is display data rather than authentication, and no other-player selector is accepted.

nodes.label: Completed-round-only source-matched player leaderboard
nodes.rationale: Latest player ticket must complete win/loss before best-valid result leaderboard; simulator/device cohort matches that player result.

nodes.label: Staff-only admin routes and independent API authorization
nodes.rationale: Login has no public signup. Admin routes and every protected API require appropriate server session; player views expose no dashboard navigation.

nodes.label: Ready freshness admission and active-round queue guards
nodes.rationale: FIFO serialized with locks, uniqueness and idempotency; stale/unready, paused/empty queue or active round blocks call. Called ticket remains assigned until resolved; skip reason is audited.

nodes.label: Private cabinetState and queueState waiting reasons
nodes.rationale: Authenticated context includes cabinetState and queueState paused/offline/busy/awaiting_operator. Ticket explains own waiting reason without exposing others; position1 is first in line, not a reservation.

nodes.label: Explicit operator call followed by physical button start
nodes.rationale: Registration never calls or starts automatically. Operator uses Call next player on admin Queue only when cabinet is ready; player then starts reserved game with physical button.

nodes.label: Explicit Queue-page simulator action sequence
nodes.rationale: When simulator enabled without physical ESP32: Set simulator ready → Call next player → Start test round → Finish win/loss. Every action remains authenticated, explicit and server-validated; no page automatically runs a round.

nodes.label: Release test ticket affects simulator reservations only
nodes.rationale: Release test ticket is limited to a simulator reservation and is not recovery for an unresolved physical-device round.

nodes.label: Durable win loss alerts with focus-refresh polling
nodes.rationale: Private state polls every2seconds/onfocus and survives reloads. Both outcomes persist notification with result, then show result/leaderboard link. Browser alerts require click/permission; no closed-tab push or guaranteed background delivery.

nodes.label: Scoped neutral administrator light and dark themes
nodes.rationale: White/slate light or charcoal dark with restrained charts; html[data-admin-theme] scopes login/screens/portals and clears on player navigation. Only theme preference is localStorage.

nodes.label: Preserved Sourcio-derived player styling and font symbols
nodes.rationale: Player registration/ticket/results/leaderboard keep gray/white/lime/softblue. Local Font Awesome webfonts, chart data graphics and canvas QR remain; unfetched Dribbble source details are not claimed.

nodes.label: Versioned SQL player-flow migrations and restricted DB access
nodes.rationale: 001 baseline and002 QR links/grants/throttling/notifications/result_source with schema_migrations. Repeatable setup provisions projectDB only; runtime CRUD restricted to it, secrets excluded.

nodes.label: Authenticated synthetic-tested device integration boundary
nodes.rationale: Heartbeat/start/result require X-Device-Token. Existing synthetic request coverage does not establish a physically connected ESP32; no device checks are run by semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Separate player admin CSRF and call-next idempotency contracts
nodes.rationale: Writes use own context/session X-CSRF-Token; admin call-next adds UUID Idempotency-Key. Single event/cabinet; multi-event administration absent.

nodes.label: Simulator evidence replay and separate device leaderboard cohort
nodes.rationale: Enabled admin-only simulator generates placement evidence through same scorer, never browser-chosen score. Mark its results, separate device leaderboard and disable before real event.

nodes.label: Dashboard aggregates currently include all result sources
nodes.rationale: Saved-source totals are labelled; source-specific production analytics remains follow-up.

nodes.label: Recorded retention deadline with future deletion and recovery operations
nodes.rationale: Notice2026-11-v1 and retention deadlines recorded. Automated purge/staffed recovery remain future work; a different browser cannot recover identity with known student ID alone.

nodes.label: Player QR scanner implementation and entry contract
nodes.rationale: Scanner documentation includes decoded-host normalization and the shared backend request-origin policy. Both current corrections remain untested at the user request.

nodes.label: Existing html5-qrcode2.3.8 scanner APIs
nodes.rationale: Lazy-loaded npm library provides Html5Qrcode.start, stop, clear and scanFile. No custom decoder or external upload service.

nodes.label: Local camera and image scanning with explicit permission
nodes.rationale: Root or /scan offers camera/upload. Permission follows a click. PNG/JPG/WebP up to8MB stay local; images/video are not sent to server or third parties.

nodes.label: Canonical local entry URL normalization across encoded hosts
nodes.rationale: Validate complete HTTP(S) /join token URL and reuse its path on the current website. Encoded localhost,127.0.0.1,LAN or other host is not rejected solely for hostname; never follow/request decoded host.

nodes.label: Backend normalized origin registered token and enabled validation
nodes.rationale: Shared origin policy checks canonical entry origin; active registered token and qr_links.enabled remain required before two-hour private grant.

nodes.label: Opening or pasting join URL no longer grants entry
nodes.rationale: Join URL opens scanner rather than exchanging a link alone. Camera/image workflow remains needed; authenticated player may return directly to own ticket.

nodes.label: QR-only scanning errors and camera cleanup
nodes.rationale: Only QR_CODE; unrelated/invalid images and inactive/unregistered tokens fail. Permission denial leaves upload available. Stop camera on detection,manual stop,file switch or leave; no camera content persistence.

nodes.label: Phone camera HTTPS and physical testing limits
nodes.rationale: Phone camera requires HTTPS secure context; localhost supports desktop development. HTTP LAN can serve image selection but not camera. Actual-phone permissions and behavior still need testing.

nodes.label: qrContent and camera-or-upload method request contract
nodes.rationale: POST /api/player/entry uses canonical decoded URL in qrContent and method camera/upload. Old token-only requests fail; media stays local and scanner has no manual token/paste field.

nodes.label: Client-reported method is not physical camera attestation
nodes.rationale: Known public QR payload can reproduce entry request. Scan-driven entry does not prove physical camera use, start a round or score. Authenticated queue and device timing boundaries remain.

nodes.label: Existing scanner suite descriptions and correction verification limits
nodes.rationale: Documentation describes scanFile and synthetic MediaStream coverage, not successful checks for current corrections or physical-phone testing.

nodes.label: Removed strict frontend origin equality rejection
nodes.rationale: Valid registered codes printed using127.0.0.1 failed onlocalhost/LAN variants. Reuse /join token path on current site while preserving registered/enabled token checks.

nodes.label: Current-event registration PNG export excluded from project graph
nodes.rationale: Export script saves current public-event PNG at frontend/public/stack-moko-baby-registration-qr.png; machine-specific artifact excluded Git/Graphify and not read/decoded for this refresh.

nodes.label: Hostname correction testing explicitly deferred by user
nodes.rationale: Regression expectations changed without tests,browser checks or build verification, at user request.

nodes.label: Shared backend browser-write and QR entry origin policy
nodes.rationale: Browser-write protection and canonical QR entry use one backend origin policy. Unrelated origins are rejected and authenticated writes retain CSRF requirements.

nodes.label: Loopback aliases retain matching scheme and port
nodes.rationale: localhost,127.0.0.1 and IPv6 loopback are explicitly permitted aliases only at the same scheme and port. This is not a wildcard acceptance of arbitrary origins.

nodes.label: Configured public additional request-host and development origins
nodes.rationale: Accept configured public website, explicit comma-separated STACK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and current request host. Development additionally permits local frontend ports5173 and4173.

nodes.label: Vite preserves public Host without rewriting browser Origin
nodes.rationale: Development/preview proxy preserves browser-facing Host for LAN usability. Origin header is unchanged. Production proxy must preserve public host or explicitly configure frontend origin.

nodes.label: Restart both servers and defer request-origin verification
nodes.rationale: Restart backend and frontend after configuration change. No tests,browser requests or build checks ran for this correction; user will test it.

nodes.label: Source-backed decisions and open gates
Primary-source research evidence
nodes.rationale: FastAPI, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Vite, Espressif, display driver, OWASP and Graphify references inform recommendations.

nodes.label: Open hardware rules TLS provider and retention decisions
nodes.rationale: Research cannot establish physical compatibility, gameplay feel or measured operational performance.

nodes.label: MySQL-compatible schema baseline with current migration override
Generated active-session and live-ticket uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Nullable generated keys enforce one active cabinet round and one live player ticket per event in MariaDB-compatible design.

nodes.label: Composite event machine queue player bindings
nodes.rationale: Candidate baseline FKs reject mismatched bindings; current versioned SQL migrations are implementation record.

nodes.label: Private identity and retention schema design
nodes.rationale: HMAC lookup/encryption protect IDs; key rotation, retention and backups remain explicit lifecycle requirements. Current implementation records purge_after but lacks automated purge.

nodes.label: Atomic result transaction and non-destructive invalidation design
nodes.rationale: Replay and atomic results/placements/queue/outbox precede ACK; valid original evidence is not overwritten by conflicting retries. Current result notification extension is in002migration.

nodes.label: MariaDB10.11 XAMPP utf8mb4_unicode_ci compatibility
nodes.rationale: Use MariaDB-compatible collation,generated columns,CHECK/windowfunctions; do not assume Oracle MySQL0900 or binary-JSON semantics.

nodes.label: Architecture baseline with current implementation override
Confirmed React JavaScript JSX Vite frontend
nodes.rationale: React JSX UI now connects to FastAPI/XAMPP per current update; older TanStackQuery/WebSocket statements are recommendations, not proof of use.

nodes.label: FastAPI Python SQLAlchemy and XAMPP runtime architecture
nodes.rationale: Native Python API with SQLAlchemy/PyMySQL and local MariaDB; current concrete dependencies are pinned in backend requirements. Runtime DBaccount is restricted.

nodes.label: Proposed ESP32 firmware remains physically unconnected
nodes.rationale: Local C++engine/display/button timing is future hardware work; synthetic device contract tests and admin simulator are distinct.

nodes.label: Historical WebSocket plan replaced by current polling implementation
nodes.rationale: Current backendREADME/player-flow explicitly claim two-second polling and no WebSocket server. WebSocket baseline is a future architecture option only.

nodes.label: Shared CSS Radix Font Awesome and Recharts foundations
nodes.rationale: Custom style tokens and accessible primitives preserve shared components; no SVG icon renderer, while charts may use SVG data graphics.

nodes.label: QR access and theme five-pass refinement log
Access flow contrast mobile and verification refinement passes
nodes.rationale: Current five passes add access/theme split, persistent multibrowser queue, admin contrast corrections, player/mobile review and release verification. Older eight-page sample review remains historical.

nodes.label: Documented current Edge accessibility unit and production checks
nodes.rationale: Document reports3 expanded end-to-end scenarios including axe on10admin route/theme combinations and both leaderboards,10frontendtests and productionbuild. Backend counts are not inferred without separate evidence.

nodes.label: Physical camera ESP32 push and production HTTPS remain untested
nodes.rationale: Review artifacts are excluded graph inputs. Automated and desktop screenshots do not prove physical phone camera scanning,ESP32,closed-tabpush or productionHTTPS.

nodes.label: Historical eight-page sample review evidence
nodes.rationale: Older sample-only statements below current update describe prior UIphase and do not supersede implemented backend/access claims.

nodes.label: Dashboard and registration design research
Admin neutral-theme and current-access research update
nodes.rationale: Current player-flow document supplies authorization/notification references; original reference language remains for player pages.

nodes.label: Primary dashboard form and custom framework research
nodes.rationale: Grafana,HomeAssistant,ThingsBoard,W3CWAI plus Radix/Recharts/FontAwesome/ReactRouter inform focused UI and accessible forms; historical preview-only limits are superseded.

nodes.label: Supplied image evidence and provisional-plan authority
nodes.rationale: Attached Sourcio/cabinet images guide visual language. Unfetched Dribbble tokens are not invented; provisional proposals do not override final user choices.

nodes.label: Connected React JavaScript frontend and access journey
Standard npm project workflow
nodes.rationale: User-installed Node/npm, terminal restart and npm ci/dev/test/build/format workflow unchanged.

nodes.label: Frontend API proxy and secret-free public base configuration
nodes.rationale: /api?local8000; XAMPP/API prerequisite. Public base URL not secret; never put DB/identity/admin secrets in frontend env.

nodes.label: Server-protected admin and QR player route separation
nodes.rationale: Five protected admin pages and distinct player scanner?grant?register?ticket?completed result?leaderboard; no guessed-route bypass.

nodes.label: Shared foundations neutral admin scope and preserved player palette
nodes.rationale: Shared CSS/Radix, scoped admin neutral themes and preserved player palette; local fonts, no SVG icons, data charts allowed, QR canvas.

nodes.label: Dashboard saved results with unknown physical readings
nodes.rationale: Saved metrics, marked simulator, unknown hardware; no invented timer/progress/WiFi. AI text deterministic/notAI-generated, no provider/device telemetry.

nodes.label: Required student ID POST only and private persistent cookie
nodes.rationale: Registration ID is cleared and never URL/storage/publicticket/analytics; server encryption and HttpOnly persistence remain. Realnetwork IDs require trustedHTTPS.

nodes.label: Isolated browser-check environment and excluded review artifacts
nodes.rationale: Documented test/build/format and dedicated browser servers/disposable DB; review images and app DB are excluded semantic inputs.

nodes.label: Stack Moko Baby frontend HTML entry
nodes.rationale: English document declares responsive viewport, gray theme color, carnival-dashboard title and PNG favicon.

nodes.label: React main.jsx module entry and root mount
nodes.rationale: HTML mounts the app at #root and loads /src/main.jsx as a module.
